title: Comfort fit, but short charge.
text: Comfort fit, but short charge.. This was my second type of chargeable mask.  Found this one to be more comfortable then my other, but the this charge doesn't even last half the time my other version does. Would be nice if it had more then one level of air flow.  It looks great, fits nice, easy to charge.  Would have given it a 5 star except the charge is way to short.
